name: How long does a bathroom window replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom window replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom window replacement typically depends on various factors, including the number of windows, their size, the complexity of the installation, and whether any structural modifications are needed. A single standard bathroom window replacement can often be completed in a few hours to a full day. However, if there are unexpected issues, extensive frame repair, or custom work involved, it could take longer. Your contractor can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific project.
